svg.text: The same question asked of the pictures. Each pair rendered at one seed with the sentence as

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the only variable, then scored by a vision model with the prompts hidden — twice, with the

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: images swapped. A win counts only when both orders agree, so a biased judge scores all ties.

svg.text: Thirty comparisons. The document never won one.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every configuration compressed the fragment — 0.73× median, shorter than its input 10 times of 10 —

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: while the prompts that win grow it twenty-fold. The matrix could not see that, and it is the only thing that mattered.
